summary: SERTEX UX improvements — 3 features fully verified end-to-end (backend + UI). All 12 backend tests pass in test_admin_user_with_license.py. Playwright confirmed: (A) admin sees 'Lisanslar' tab (not 'Lisansım'), 'Yeni Kullanıcı Ekle' form has a working license dropdown [admin-add-license] with exactly ["","trial","monthly","yearly","lifetime"] and hides when role=admin; user created via UI with trial license logs in and skips the RedeemScreen. (B) A regular user (fresh TEST_ux_expir_*) with a trial license patched to expires_at≈5d shows the fixed amber banner [license-expiring-banner] with text 'Lisansın 4 gün sonra bitecek — yakında yenilemeni öneririm.' at top. (C) Regular user Settings shows 'Lisansım' tab (not 'Lisanslar'/'Users'); MyLicense card renders type_label 'Deneme (30 gün)', '4 gün kaldı', bitiş date, key with copy icon, plus 'YENİ KOD KULLAN' input+submit. Banner is NOT shown for admin. No banner double-render (only 1 element with data-testid).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_create_user: license assignment is transactional-friendly — key is generated then redeemed for the just-created user. Good. If create_licenses succeeds but redeem_license fails, the license row is orphaned (unassigned). Consider wrapping in try/except and cleaning up the orphan on failure so no dangling key remains.

with_license validation is done AFTER user insert (line 247-248). Invalid value raises 400 but user has already been created — leaves an orphan user in DB. Move the LICENSE_TYPES membership check BEFORE db.users.insert_one().

MyLicense.jsx: `daysLeft !== null` check is fine but `daysLeft` could be undefined for admin/no-license responses; consider `typeof daysLeft === 'number'` for consistency with SertexMain.jsx line 417 (which already does that).
SertexMain.jsx expiring banner uses `licenseState.status.days_left <= 7` — fine. Consider re-checking when window regains focus (already polled every 60s so acceptable).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 3 features verified via Playwright — admin tab, license dropdown, UI-created user login, expiring banner, Lisansım tab card+key+redeem input)

seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_ux_* users and licenses, then cleanup at module teardown. Frontend test used TEST_ux_expir_* (trial, patched to ~5 days remaining) — cleaned up after test run. TEST_uicreate_* user (created via UI) also cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_admin_user_with_license.py MUST be run with `-o addopts=""` (no xdist) because the license/session-kick guard fires when parallel workers login as the same fresh user. Fixture helpers in test file: _create_via_admin(admin, tag, with_license=...) posts to /api/admin/users. For UI expiring-banner testing, create a fresh user via POST /api/admin/users with with_license='trial', then PATCH /api/admin/licenses/{id} with extend_days=-25 to reach ~5 days remaining. The banner uses licenseState polled every 60s in SertexMain, but initial fetch on mount is immediate. MyLicense component fetches /api/license/me on tab mount — wait 2-3s after clicking the tab before asserting the status card is present.
rca of the issue: No issues found. Two minor code-quality recommendations (see critical_code_review_comments) are enhancements, not bugs.
